rows.headline: How data leakage manufactured a perfect Bank Nifty prediction in machine learning models
rows.hook: Flawed machine learning created fake trading edge
rows.summary: A study highlights how data leakage in machine learning models can manufacture a fake trading edge, producing seemingly perfect Bank Nifty predictions. This occurs when future information accidentally enters the training dataset, skewing backtest results and creating unrealistic performance expectations. Retail algorithmic traders and quants relying on flawed historical testing risk deploying capital into strategies that inevitably fail in live markets. Understanding this vulnerability helps investors evaluate algorithmic trading claims more critically.
rows.why_it_matters: Backtested algorithmic trading claims may hide severe data flaws.
